messages:
jordan: Quick weird bet — Rockies game on tonight. Anyone want to wager office pizza on whether the color commentator says 'hot corner' 3+ times? :laughing: I say yes.

sam: I'm in for the under. Chips and salsa if I win. :chipmunk: (jk)

kevin: Over. I'll bring a 6-pack if they hit 3. Beer bet accepted.

maddie: Can I blindly support both sides and just request pizza? :taco: GIF https://giphy.com/gifs/baseball-hype-3o7aD2saalBwwftBIW

jordan: lol ok tally: jordan pizza | sam chips | kevin beer. Also — anyone streaming from the rooftop? I can bring a small speaker.

sam: I'll be on the rooftop at 7.5 with nacho hat.

kevin: ETA 7:20. If announcer says 'hot corner' within first 3 innings I double down.

delivery-bot: Reminder: Free pizza pool to be collected in #random-pots by 6:45pm. Use /collect 5 to commit.

maddie: Also quick poll — who wants pepperoni vs veggie? React with :pizza: for pepperoni, :leafy_green: for veggie.

sam: :pizza:

kevin: :pizza:

jordan: :leafy_green: (chefs salad)

maddie: Awesome — pepperoni wins. I'll place an order if the bets settle. :thumbsup: 

kevin: Also, side prop: will announcer mispronounce 'Rox' as 'rocks'? 50/50.

sam: Nah, their Twitter team will correct them too fast.

jordan: Alright team, see you on the roof. Loser buys donuts monday? :coffee:

kevin: Deal. :fist_bump:
